title: A summand determinant is locally a matrix characteristic polynomial
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, n a finite index set, and T,P matrices with P*P=P and T*P=P*T. For D(T,P) defined in [def-weil-pbc-idempotent-charpoly], there exist a finite family f_i generating the unit ideal and, for each i, a natural number d_i and a d_i by d_i matrix U_i over A localized away from f_i, such that the coefficientwise localization of D(T,P) is the characteristic polynomial of U_i. No condition on the global leading coefficient is asserted.

source.place: Tag 09XI, lemma-characterize-henselian-pair, proof of (3) implies (1), splitting and characteristic-polynomial paragraphs; local matrix realization made explicit by R2

proof.text: Reindex the ambient module by Fin (card n). Apply [lem-weil-pbc-idempotent-endomorphism-image-base-change] to P and 1-P to obtain complementary finite projective images and their base-change identifications.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-finite-projective-standard-free-cover] to both images. Refine the two finite standard covers by all pairwise products. The products span the unit ideal because the product of two expressions for 1 in the original spans is an expression for 1 in the product span. Localizing further preserves freeness and the split decomposition.

On each refined localization, concatenate finite bases of the two images. The commuting equation makes T preserve both images, so P is diag(1,0) and T is diag(U,V). The polynomial matrix from [def-weil-pbc-idempotent-charpoly] is then diag(X-U,1). Determinants commute with ring maps and basis change, and the determinant of this block matrix is U.charpoly. Enumerate the cover by Fin r; the size of U can vary by cover member. Over the zero ring or an empty ambient matrix the equality is immediate with d=0.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_standardCover_idempotentCharpoly_eq_charpoly
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] {n : Type v} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (T P : Matrix n n A) (hP : P * P = P) (hTP : T * P = P * T) :
    ∃ (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A), Ideal.span (Set.range f) = ⊤ ∧
      ∀ i : Fin r, ∃ (d : ℕ) (U : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) (Localization.Away (f i))),
        (idempotentCharpoly T P).map (algebraMap A (Localization.Away (f i))) =
          U.charpoly
